findings.body: A repo pinned to `v1.3.0-rc.1` cannot run `forge upgrade v1.3.0`: `_numbers` discards the prerelease suffix, so line 79 treats both versions as equal and refuses. Prerelease pins are accepted by `src/forge/repo.py:142` and its validation at line 286, and the corresponding stable release is newer under [semantic-version precedence](https://semver.org/#spec-item-11). Preserve that distinction when comparing the requested stable release with the existing pin.
findings.title: Compare prerelease pins before rejecting their stable release
